description: This file defines the IdempotencyKeyResolver class, which resolves idempotency keys for commands in the Fineract project. It interacts with request context holders and key generators to ensure unique command identifiers.

classes.name: IdempotencyKeyResolver
classes.description: Component handling the resolution of idempotency keys for commands, ensuring uniqueness and idempotency handling.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves an idempotency key for a given CommandWrapper, defaulting to generating a new key if none is provided.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the idempotency key attribute from the request context if available.
